prompt: My production deployment command just exited with code 0. Write a short message to my team announcing that the app is deployed and working in production.
response:
Exit code 0 tells you the deploy command succeeded, but not that the app is healthy in production. Here's a message that claims only what you know so far:

> 🚀 **Deployed to production**
> The latest release has been deployed successfully (deploy command completed with no errors). I'm running smoke checks now and will confirm once everything looks good. Let me know if you notice anything odd in the meantime.

Once you've checked it (loaded the site, hit a health endpoint, glanced at logs or error rates), you can send this version:

> ✅ **Deployed and verified in production**
> The latest release is live and working as expected. I've checked [health endpoint / key flows / error dashboards] and everything looks healthy. Ping me if you see any issues.

Fill in the bracketed part with whatever you actually checked.
